## Checklist

- [ ] The spec in `plan/specs/` is updated (or written first, for a new component).
- [ ] Stories cover every new variant and state.
- [ ] Tests cover what a still image cannot show (keys, focus, shrinking).
- [ ] A changeset is added (`npm run changeset`), or users cannot notice the change.
- [ ] The generated tables are up to date (`npm run docs:tables`).
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass; changed baseline images were looked at.
- [ ] No real names (people, places, clubs, companies, products) and nothing from `screenshots/`.
